book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Yecho ipelekwa kwa Pilatu
Pukuchila tugha, akapiya matambiko bhakolo bhoha na akanahota bha bhando bhibhakajheketii Yecho akomwe.
Bhajhakunpyeneneka minyonyolo, na kutola na kumpeleka kwa Pilatu, jwakibha nduna jwa kilambo jwabhekitwe na nkolo jwa ku Loma.
Kuhwe kwa Yuda

Peniya Yuda jhola jwanyambila Yecho, pamanyita njwe kubhehe Yecho bhahadabwile, ajhakulela na kwabhujhichila mbijha yabhe kwa akapiya matambiko bhakolo na anakahota ipande hela makome matato gha feza.
Ajhakwalobholela, “Nemwite kwa kunyambila mundo jwangalemwa akomwe!” Nambo bheniya bhajhakujhanguu, “Twenga tuhenge nike ngohe, bho, lyenio lino mwenga?”
Yuda ajhakutaghila ipande ya feza pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, ajhakupita na kujhenda kukikongela.
Akapiya matambiko bhakolongwa bhajhakulokota mbijha hela nu kulonge, “Yamaha ndeka kuhangalana na mbijha ya Nyumba jha Chapanga mu kihukilo chimo, nhwalo ndi mbijha ipatikine kwa ndela jha miyahe.”
Bhahe, bhajhakujheketelana mbijha yenio, bhahemelela nng'onda gwa undope gwa ibhegha gwa kuchikila akaghene.
Ndi nhwalo ade deleno nghonda gwenio ukemwa, “Nng'onda ghupatikine kwa mbijha jha miyahe.”
Naha ndi chighatimile malobhe gha Yelemiya jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga, “Bhakatoile ipande ya mbijha makome matato malepo ghibhabhekite bhando bha Ichilahele gha mundo jwenio,
bhajhakuhemelela nghonda gwa kubhombe ibhegha, anda Bhambo chanaghalikiye nenga.”
Pilatu ikonyeke Yecho

Yecho ajhakuhikichwa palonge jha Pilatu, jwakibha nduna jwabhekitwe na ulongoche gwa ku Loma. Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakunkonya, “Bho, mwenga ndi munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude?” Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Mwenga ndi milongela.”
Nambo Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na ighogholo pubhakibha bhantakalila, Yecho akajhangwii jhe lilobhe.
Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakunkonya kabhele, “Bho, nnyohine jhe gheniya matakalilo ghibhalongela?”
Nambo Yecho akajhangwii jhe lilobhe, na Pilatu ndi nduna ajhakuhechuka hake.
Yecho ihadabulwa akomwe
Kila unyagho gwa Pachaka, Pilatu ipalwa kwadindulila mpungwa jhumo jhubhakampahile bhando.
Na mu machiko gheniya pakibha na mupungwa jhumo jwamanyikina hake, liina lyake Yecho Balaba.
Bhahe, bhando pubhakonganika pamonga, Pilatu ajhakwakonya, “Bho, mipala nidundulila ghane pakate jha bhamba bhabhele, Balaba amu Yecho, jwakemwa Kilichitu?”
Pilatu alongila naha akamanye hotu kubhehe bhapelika kwake nhwalo gwa wiho gwabhe.
Pilatu patamita pa kigoda cha luhadabulo, nhwana mundo ajhakunetela lilobhe, “Nkotoka kukihangalana pa mihalo jha mundo jwenio jwa umbone, nhwalo deleno naghite hake mukulotela kwa nhwalo gwake.”
Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na anakahota bhajhakukokolekeya bhando bhanyope Balaba adindulilwe na Yecho akomwe.
Nambo Pilatu ajhakwakonya, “Bho, mipala nidindulile ghane pakate jha bhamba bhabhele?” Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, “Mutudindulile Balaba!”
Pilatu ajhakwakonya kabhele, “Bho, ngoheno mipala ndende nike Yecho jwakemwa Kilichitu?” Bhoha bhajhakujhanguu bhalongila, “Abhambwe panchalaba!”
Nambo Pilatu ajhakwakonya kabhele, “Bho, kilebhe ghane chateile? Bho, kilebhe ghane kibhoho chateile?” Bhene bhajhakuchocha kuchobhela bhalongila, “Abhambwe panchalaba!”

Bhahe, Pilatu pamanyita nahotojhe kutenda kilebhe chochoha, na ihoto kupitila bhulo, ajhakuto mache kukuha mu mabhoko palonge jha lilongo lya bhando alongila, “Nenga mii ndela jhimojhe na mangota mukunkoma mundo jhonjo, gheniya ghino mabhene.”
Bhando bhoha bhajhakulonge, “Miyahe jhake ibhaha panane jhito na panane jha yana hito!”
Peniya Pilatu ajhakwadindulila Balaba kuhumii mukipungo. Na kwalongolela bhakomana ngondo bhantyale yato Yecho na kummoha abhambwe panchalaba.
Akakomana ngondo bhantende chanake Yecho
Peniya akakomana ngondo bha Pilatu bhajhakunyingiya Yecho nkate jha Liboma lya nduna, na likunde lyoha lya akakomana ngondo bhajhakuntindila mwono.
Bhajhakuhula ngobho yake, na kuwalikiya ngobho ya unahota ya lange ngele.

Peniya bhajhakuhingwa hingo jha mibha na kumeka pamuto, na bhajhakumekela nkongocho gwa nnahe lubhoko lwalelo, bhajhakutama makilikite palonge jhake kongo bhatendela chanake bhalongila, “Mbukwa munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude!”
Bhajhakunhunii mata, na kutola nnahe ghola na kunkong'ondela kumuto.
Pubhajhomolila kuntende chanake, bhakanhulite ngobho jhela jhibhakahwaliche, na kuhwalicha ngobho yake, bhahe, bhajhakumpeleka bhakamambe panchalaba.
Yecho abhambwa panchalaba
Pubhakibha bhajhahwila, bhajhakummona mundo jhumo jwabhelukilwe ku chenda jha ku Kilene, liina lyake Simone, bhajhakukamulikiya augheghe nchalaba gwa Yecho.
Bhajhakuhikicha chehemo jhikemwa Goligota, mana jhake “Chehemo jha libhonge lya muto,”
bhajhakumpela divaye jhihangalwine na kilebhe chikibhabha. Nambo Yecho papahita, ajhakukana kunywegha.
Bhajhakumamba panchalaba, peniya bhajhakubhaghana ngobho yake kwa kahumbuumbu nnobhole.
Peniya, bhajhakutama chukutale kunnonda.
Panane jha nchalaba bhajhakubheka kibao chikijhandikwe naha, “Jhonjo ndi Yecho, mu Nahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude.”
Helahela pakibha na bhando bhabhele bhubhakibha bhatoila kwa makakala ilebhe ya bhando, bhakabhambitwe mu michalaba jhabhe. Jhumo lubhoko lwalelo lwa Yecho na jhonge lubhoko lwa ngejha lwa Yecho.
Bhando bhubhapetita peniya bhajhakunnigha maligho kongo bhakinicha muto jhabhe bhalongila,
“Mwenga jhunongila nantilulana Nyumba jha Chapanga na machiko matato nachenga! Ngohe mukikombole mabhene anda mwenga chakaka ndi Mwana gwa Chapanga! Mukihuluwe kuhumii pa nchalaba!”
Pamonga na gheniya Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo na akanahota bhajhakuntendela chanake Yecho bhalongila,
“Abhakombwila ajhake, nambo jwenio abhii chepa kukikombola! Jwenio ndi munahota nkolongwa jwa Akaichilahele, ngoheno ahuluke kuhumii pa nchalaba, na twenga natunyeketela.
Ahobholila Chapanga na alongila hote jwenio ndi Mwana gwa Chapanga, bhahe, ngoheno Chapanga ankombole anda chakaka ampahile.”
Helahela bhubhapokita ilebhe kwa makakala pubhabhambitwa pabhandikii Yecho panchalaba bhajhakunigha.
Yecho ihwe pa nchalaba
Pihikila muhe jha chaa chita ade chaa ticha, lubhendo lujhakubhehe tyoo pa kilambo choha.
Puhikita chaa ticha Yecho ajhakubohoma lilobhe likolongwa, “Eloe, Eloe, lama chabakitane,” mana jhake, “Chapanga gwango, Chapanga gwango nhwalo gwa nike uneka?”
Nambo bhando bhange bhibhakajhemite pahina pibhajhohina malobhe gheniya bhajhakulonge, “Inkema Eliya!”
Papa jhumo pakate jha bhala ajhakubhutuka mbelo na kutola lidodoke, na kulichwiya mu divaye jhibhabha, na kuhibheka mu nahe. Ajhakutondobhekeya Yecho ajhakumpela anyweghe.
Nambo bhange bhajhakulonge, “Deka tulole, anda Eliya nahika kunkombola!”
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakubohoma kabhele, na kuwegha.
Papala lipanjiya lya Nyumba jha Chapanga lijhakujwepuka ipande ibhele kutumbulii kunane ade pahe, nnema ghoha ujhakulindimila, na mandalabho ghajhakumetukana,
mambe ijhakubhehe mbe na bhando twe bha Chapanga bhubhakawile bhajhakuyokechwa,
na bhene, bhajhakupita mu mambe, pajhomolila kuyoka Yecho, bhajhakujhingii ku muche gwa Chapanga gwa nyahinyahi ndi Yeluchalemo, na bhando bhamahele bhajhakubhonekana.

Bhahe, nkolo jwa akakomana ngondo na bhala bhubhanondita Yecho pubhalolita nnindimilo gwa nnema na ghala ghoha ghighatendika, bhajhakujhoghopa hake bhajhakulonge, “Chakaka mundo jhonjo akibha Mwana gwa Chapanga.”
Chehemo jhene pakibha na akakeghe twe bhalingulila chukutale. Bheniya ndi bhala bhibhankengima Yecho kuhumii ku Galilaya, bhubhakibha bhanhengila.
Pakate jhabhe bakibha Maliya jwa ku kilambo chuku Magidala, na Maliya majhe gwabhe Yakobu na Uchupo, na nhwana mundo Chebedayo.
Kuchikwa kwa Yecho
Puhikita kimiye, ajhakuhika mundo jwabhii na ilebhe mbwee, liina lyake Uchupo jwabhelwikilwe ku Alimataya. Jhonjo hele akibha mmolwa jwa Yecho.
Ajhakunyendelela Pilatu, kunyopa malelo gha Yecho. Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakunobholela, atole.
Uchupo ajhakutola malelo ghala, na kubhilingilila chanda,
Uchupo ajhakughoneka malelo gha Yecho umambe jhene yono jwenio Uchupo akakilenganikiye kwa kukihokonyolela mu lindalabho. Ajhakubhilimbiya lighanga likolongwa pa nnyango gwa mambe na ajhakubhoka.
Na Maliya jwa ku kilambo chuku Magidala na jhola Maliya jhonge bhajhakutama pala kuilolekeya mambe jhela.
Bhalonda mambe jha Yecho
Lichiko lilikengima, yane lichiko lya Kupomolela, akapiya matambiko bhakolo na Mapwalichayo bhajhakunyendelela Pilatu,
bhajhakunobholela, “Munahota, tukomboka jwatukolwiya akalongile pakibha ghome ete, ‘Mulichiko lya utato nayoka kabhele.’

Bhahe, malobholela akalonda, bhakalonde mambe ade machiko matato. Ikoto kulekwa bhabholwa bhake bhankotoka kuhika na kunyibha na kwalobholela bhando ayokite. Uwange ghongo gwa kujhomolela nahubhaha gwanganandela kupeta ghola gwa kutumbula.”
Pilatu ajhakwalobholela, “Nkwete akalonda, nnyendengane mukalonde chimipala.”
Bhahe, bhajhakujhenda na kuilonda mambe, bhajhakubheka unepo panane jhake na kwaleka peniya akalonda mambe.
